items.title: Anthropic warns that it’s very close to RSI capability, aka self-building AI
items.snippet: RSI is the point at which AI grows so good at training itself that it spawns a dramatic acceleration of AI capabilities. To the AI doomers, RSI represents the cataclysm from which there is no return.
items.title_ar: Anthropic تحذر من قرب بلوغ قدرة RSI
items.summary_ar: حذرت Anthropic من أنها أصبحت قريبة جداً من قدرة RSI، أي أنظمة ذكاء اصطناعي تبني نفسها وتحسن عملية تدريب نفسها. يؤدي هذا النوع من التحسن الذاتي إلى تسارع كبير في قدرات الموديلات.
items.why_ar: فهم مفهوم RSI مهم لتقييم سرعة تطور الموديلات والمخاطر المرتبطة بها عند تصميم أنظمة الذكاء الاصطناعي.
items.title_en: Anthropic warns it is very close to RSI capability
items.summary_en: Anthropic warns that it is very close to RSI capability, meaning AI that becomes so good at training itself that it causes a dramatic acceleration of AI capabilities. The article describes RSI as a point that some AI doomers see as a cataclysm with no return.
items.why_en: Understanding RSI helps you assess how fast frontier models may improve and what safety risks that creates for systems you build.

items.title: TinyAstral: Transferring Self-Evolving Harnesses to Tiny Generalist Manipulation Agents
items.snippet: Robot agents built on vision-language models depend on both the planner and its harness: the tools, feedback, memory, and recovery logic around it. Can improvements to a large teacher's harness be carried into a compact agent with lower inference compute cost? We present TinyAstral, a two-stage approach. We first freeze an open-weight teacher and improve its harness through recursive self-improvement (RSI): frontier LLM agents read the teacher's trajectories and propose harness edits, and each edit is accepted only if it passes a paired statistical test. We then freeze the final harness, collect teacher trajectories with reasoning and failure recovery, and distill a small student that replac
items.title_ar: TinyAstral: نقل harness ذاتي التطور إلى agents روبوتية صغيرة
items.summary_ar: يقترح البحث نهجاً من مرحلتين: يحسن الفريق harness لـ teacher كبير عبر RSI، حيث تقترح LLM agents تعديلات تُقبل فقط بعد اجتياز اختبار إحصائي. بعد ذلك يُدرَّب student صغير بالـ distillation ليحل محل الـ teacher بتكلفة inference أقل.
items.why_ar: فكرة نقل التحسينات من teacher إلى student بتكلفة حوسبة أقل تستحق التجربة في روبوتات أو agents لديك.
items.title_en: TinyAstral: transferring self-evolving harnesses to tiny robot agents
items.summary_en: The paper proposes a two-stage approach where a large open-weight teacher's harness is improved through RSI, with frontier LLM agents proposing edits accepted only after a paired statistical test. A small student agent is then distilled from the teacher's trajectories, including reasoning and failure recovery, to reduce inference compute cost.
items.why_en: The teacher-to-student distillation idea with a harness-improvement loop is worth testing if you build compact agents or robotic manipulation pipelines.

items.title: Self-Improvement with Auxiliary Rewards: Learning from Verified Traces and Evaluating Transfer
items.snippet: Answer-level rewards cannot distinguish reasoning traces with equally correct outcomes. We study whether auxiliary trajectory preferences improve small-language-model self-improvement and transfer under limited supervision. We compare confidence-based (SC) and entropy-based metrics (UID-Conj.), which combines global entropy variation and local smoothness, through online reward augmentation and offline training on correct responses. Online experiments adapt Qwen3-1.7B on 30 AIME problems without reference answers; offline experiments use historical AIME problems. UID-Conj. improves the online macro-average across the adaptation benchmark and three transfer benchmarks by 2.08 percentage points
items.title_ar: تحسين ذاتي للموديلات الصغيرة باستخدام auxiliary rewards
items.summary_ar: يدرس البحث هل تفضيلات مسار الاستدلال ترفع قدرة small-language-models على self-improvement والنقل تحت supervision محدود. يقارن الباحثون مقياس confidence-based مع مقياس entropy-based باسم UID-Conj، ويطبقانهما عبر online reward augmentation وoffline training على الإجابات الصحيحة. بحسب النص، يرفع UID-Conj المتوسط الكلي عبر benchmark التكيف وثلاثة benchmarks للنقل بمقدار 2.08 نقطة مئوية.
items.why_ar: فكرة تستحق POC سريعة لتحسين موديل صغير مثل Qwen3-1.7B بدون reference answers.
items.title_en: Self-Improvement with Auxiliary Rewards for Small Models
items.summary_en: The paper studies whether auxiliary trajectory preferences improve self-improvement and transfer for small language models under limited supervision. It compares a confidence-based metric (SC) with an entropy-based metric (UID-Conj), applied through online reward augmentation and offline training on correct responses. The reported result is that UID-Conj improves the online macro-average across the adaptation benchmark and three transfer benchmarks by 2.08 percentage points.
items.why_en: A quick POC candidate for improving a small model like Qwen3-1.7B without reference answers.

items.title: N1nEmAn/sapper-v2
items.snippet: Autonomous pentest legion — AI commander + worker swarm + layered fact-intent graph. 3rd Tencent Intelligent Attack-Defense online champion (634 teams · 8h unattended · 1B tokens beat 4.5B). The Nüwa Test: give AIs Create/Language/History, let a civilization grow.
items.title_ar: sapper-v2: وكيل pentest مستقل بسرب من agents
items.summary_ar: مشروع open-source لوكيل اختبار اختراق مستقل، يعتمد على AI commander مع سرب من worker agents و layered fact-intent graph. حقق المشروع المركز الثالث في بطولة Tencent Intelligent Attack-Defense ضمن 634 فريقاً، بعمل متواصل 8 ساعات وباستهلاك 1B token مقابل 4.5B لمنافس آخر.
items.why_ar: فكرة POC قوية لأتمتة اختبارات الاختراق بتعدد الوكلاء، وتستحق دراسة معمارية الـ agents فيها.
items.title_en: sapper-v2: autonomous pentest agent with a worker swarm
items.summary_en: An open-source autonomous pentest agent with an AI commander, a swarm of worker agents, and a layered fact-intent graph. It placed 3rd in the Tencent Intelligent Attack-Defense online competition among 634 teams, running unattended for 8 hours using 1B tokens versus 4.5B for a rival.
items.why_en: It is a strong POC idea for automating pentesting with multi-agent coordination, and its agent architecture is worth studying.

items.title: eliasbiondo/antirion
items.snippet: 🕷️ The fastest open-source AI Gateway and LLM Gateway — one binary with built-in console to route, secure, budget and observe every LLM call across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock and more.
items.title_ar: antirion: بوابة LLM gateway سريعة في binary واحد
items.summary_ar: بوابة AI مفتوحة المصدر تأتي كملف binary واحد مع console مدمج. تتيح توجيه كل استدعاء LLM وتأمينه وضبط budget له ومراقبته عبر OpenAI و Anthropic و Gemini و Bedrock وغيرها.
items.why_ar: تستحق التجربة إذا كنت تحتاج طبقة موحدة لإدارة استدعاءات الموديلات وتكاليفها ومراقبتها.
items.title_en: antirion: a fast single-binary LLM gateway with a built-in console
items.summary_en: An open-source AI gateway shipped as one binary with a built-in console. It routes, secures, budgets, and observes every LLM call across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock, and more.
items.why_en: It is worth testing if you need a single layer to manage model calls, their costs, and their observability.

items.title: ctoldigital/axuse
items.snippet: Accessibility-first browser & computer use for AI agents — one MCP server for every harness (Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Antigravity). Instruments the DOM/accessibility tree via CDP instead of screenshot loops: diffed snapshots, stable element refs, trusted input, typed errors. Zero dependencies
items.title_ar: axuse: MCP server لتصفح الحاسوب بواسطة وكلاء AI
items.summary_ar: MCP server واحد لأدوات التصفح والتحكم بالحاسوب، ويعمل مع Codex و Claude Code و OpenCode و Antigravity. بدلاً من حلقات لقطات الشاشة، يقرأ DOM و accessibility tree عبر CDP مع snapshots مقارنة ومراجع عناصر ثابتة وأخطاء محددة النوع، ويعمل بدون أي dependencies.
items.why_ar: تقنية تستحق التجربة إذا كنت تبني وكلاء يتفاعلون مع واجهات ويب داخلية.
items.title_en: axuse: accessibility-first browser control for AI agents via MCP
items.summary_en: A single MCP server for browser and computer use that works across Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, and Antigravity. Instead of screenshot loops, it reads the DOM and accessibility tree via CDP, with diffed snapshots, stable element refs, trusted input, and typed errors, and has zero dependencies.
items.why_en: It is worth trying if you are building agents that interact with internal web interfaces.

items.title: Goldman bans traders and bankers from using AI coding tools
items.snippet: Goldman Sachs has banned traders and other employees from using advanced AI tools for coding over productivity and risk concerns, according to Bloomberg
items.title_ar: Goldman Sachs تحظر على المتداولين والموظفين استخدام أدوات AI للبرمجة
items.summary_ar: منعت Goldman Sachs المتداولين وموظفين آخرين من استخدام أدوات AI المتقدمة في البرمجة، بسبب مخاوف تتعلق بالإنتاجية والمخاطر. الخبر منقول عن Bloomberg.
items.why_ar: يوضح هذا القرار كيف تقيّد البنوك coding assistants، وهو عامل مهم عند تصميم أي POC موجه للمطورين داخل بنك.
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs bans AI coding tools for traders and bankers
items.summary_en: Goldman Sachs has banned traders and other employees from using advanced AI tools for coding, citing productivity and risk concerns. The report is attributed to Bloomberg.
items.why_en: It shows how banks restrict coding assistants, which matters when designing any developer-facing POC inside a bank.

items.title: Dost launches AskDost to give finance teams their own AI agents
items.snippet: Dost, the native-AI finance automation platform, has launched AskDost, an AI business intelligence assistant built for finance and operations teams. AskDost connects to a company’s ERP and other financial data sources, answers questions in natural language, executes finance workflows once a human approves them, and lets each team run AI agents on its own data.
items.title_ar: Dost تطلق AskDost لمنح فرق المالية وكلاء AI خاصين بها
items.summary_ar: أطلقت منصة Dost لأتمتة المالية المبنية على AI مساعد ذكاء أعمال اسمه AskDost موجهاً لفرق المالية والعمليات. يتصل المساعد بنظام ERP للشركة ومصادر البيانات المالية الأخرى، ويجيب عن الأسئلة بلغة طبيعية، وينفذ سير العمل المالية بعد موافقة بشرية. كما يتيح لكل فريق تشغيل وكلاء AI خاصين به على بياناته.
items.why_ar: يمثل نموذجاً عملياً لوكلاء AI مع human approval في العمليات المالية، وهو مرجع مفيد لتصميم POC داخلي في البنك.
items.title_en: Dost launches AskDost to give finance teams their own AI agents
items.summary_en: Dost, a native-AI finance automation platform, launched AskDost, a business intelligence assistant for finance and operations teams. It connects to a company's ERP and other financial data sources, answers questions in natural language, and executes finance workflows after human approval. Each team can also run its own AI agents on its own data.
items.why_en: It is a practical reference for building an internal banking POC with AI agents that require human approval in finance operations.

items.title: Y Combinator’s Garry Tan uses AI agents so much, he spends up to $200K a year on tokens
items.snippet: Y Combinator Garry Tan has jokingly admitted that he's suffered from "cyber psychosis” and barely sleeps sometimes because he’s so excited to be working with his AI agents. On a new episode of Walter Isaacson’s podcast, The Builders, Tan put a price tag on his passion.
items.title_ar: Garry Tan من Y Combinator ينفق حتى 200 ألف دولار سنوياً على tokens
items.summary_ar: يقول Garry Tan من Y Combinator إنه يستخدم AI agents بكثافة، وإنه ينفق حتى 200 ألف دولار سنوياً على tokens. ذكر ذلك في حلقة جديدة من بودكاست The Builders لـ Walter Isaacson.
items.why_ar: يعطي صورة واقعية لتكلفة استخدام agents بكثافة، وهذا مهم عند تقدير ميزانية inference لأي POC.
items.title_en: Y Combinator's Garry Tan spends up to $200K a year on AI agent tokens
items.summary_en: Garry Tan of Y Combinator says he uses AI agents so heavily that he spends up to $200K a year on tokens. He made the remark on a new episode of Walter Isaacson's podcast, The Builders.
items.why_en: It gives a concrete sense of real token costs for heavy agent usage, which matters when budgeting a POC.

items.title: llm 0.37
items.snippet: Release: llm 0.37 There's a lot of stuff in this new release of my LLM CLI tool and Python library, representing around two months of accumulated features and fixes. I added gpt-6.1-sol and gpt-6.1-terra , plus a new llm openai endpoint add command to make it easier to configure additional models that use OpenAI-compatible endpoints. I switched the default model (if you have not set your own default) to gpt-6-luna - half the price of the previous default, gpt-5.6-luna . LLM's support for embeddi
items.title_ar: إصدار llm 0.37 مع موديلات OpenAI جديدة وأمر لإضافة endpoints
items.summary_ar: أصدر Simon Willison الإصدار 0.37 من أداة LLM CLI ومكتبة Python، ويضم ميزات وإصلاحات تراكمت على مدى نحو شهرين. أُضيف موديلا gpt-6.1-sol و gpt-6.1-terra، مع أمر llm openai endpoint add لتسهيل إضافة موديلات تعمل عبر OpenAI-compatible endpoints. تغيّر الموديل الافتراضي إلى gpt-6-luna بنصف سعر الافتراضي السابق gpt-5.6-luna.
items.why_ar: أداة CLI مفيدة لتجربة عدة موديلات بسرعة وتوحيد إعداد endpoints المتوافقة مع OpenAI في الـ POCs.
items.title_en: llm 0.37 adds new OpenAI models and an endpoint add command
items.summary_en: Simon Willison released llm 0.37, a CLI tool and Python library, bundling about two months of features and fixes. It adds gpt-6.1-sol and gpt-6.1-terra, plus a command to configure OpenAI-compatible endpoints. The default model is now gpt-6-luna, at half the price of the previous default gpt-5.6-luna.
items.why_en: It is a handy CLI for quickly testing several models and standardizing OpenAI-compatible endpoints in POCs.

items.title: From Fragmentation to Fusion: A Survey and Roadmap for Omnimodal Embeddings
items.snippet: Embedding models underpin virtually every modern AI system, from search engines to recommendation systems. Despite shared mathematical foundations, research on embedding models remains fragmented by modality: the communities develop largely in isolation, seldom exchanging insights. We argue that this fragmentation obscures a deeper convergence. Driven by contrastive learning, Transformer architectures, and a granularity shift, embedding research across modalities is converging toward a common set of principles, even as modality-specific challenges remain underexplored. To reason across this convergence without conflating it, we propose a framework of three progressively harder capabilities:
items.title_ar: من التجزئة إلى الاندماج: مسح ومخطط لـ embeddings متعددة الوسائط
items.summary_ar: يرى البحث أن أبحاث embedding models مجزأة حسب الوسيلة، لكنها تتقارب نحو مبادئ مشتركة بدفع من contrastive learning وTransformer. يقترح الباحثون إطاراً من ثلاث قدرات تتزايد صعوبتها تدريجياً لتحليل هذا التقارب.
items.why_ar: مرجع مفيد لبناء أنظمة embeddings متعددة الوسائط، ولكتابة مراجعة بحثية حول هذا الموضوع.
items.title_en: From Fragmentation to Fusion: a survey and roadmap for omnimodal embeddings
items.summary_en: The survey argues that embedding research is fragmented by modality but is converging toward common principles driven by contrastive learning and Transformer architectures. It proposes a framework of three progressively harder capabilities to reason about this convergence.
items.why_en: It is a useful reference for building multimodal embedding systems and a possible starting point for a research review on the topic.

items.title: DecisionRank: On-Policy Distillation for Decision-Model Rerankers
items.snippet: Decision models target structured tasks by directly predicting choices or scores, avoiding autoregressive decoding latency. However, transferring a generative LLM's ranking knowledge to a decision model remains challenging: the teacher expresses preferences through a ranked list of document ID sequences, while the student determines the ranking using scores from the first-token position. To bridge this gap, we introduce DecisionRank, a decision model trained through item-space on-policy distillation (OPD). Item-space OPD constructs the student's rollout by sorting its document scores into a ranked sequence. A generative teacher takes the resulting ranking list as inputs and provides conditio
items.title_ar: DecisionRank: on-policy distillation لنماذج decision-model rerankers
items.summary_ar: تقترح الورقة DecisionRank، وهو decision model يُدرّب عبر item-space on-policy distillation لنقل معرفة الترتيب من teacher توليدي. يبني الـ student rollout بترتيب document scores الخاصة به، ثم يستقبل المعلم هذه القائمة كمدخل ويقدم إشارة تدريب. الهدف تجاوز الفجوة بين قوائم ID متسلسلة وبين scores من first-token position، مع تجنب latency الناتج عن autoregressive decoding.
items.why_ar: مفيد لمن يبني rerankers سريعة الاستدلال داخل أنظمة RAG ويريد تجنب تكلفة decoding للـ LLM.
items.title_en: DecisionRank: On-Policy Distillation for Decision-Model Rerankers
items.summary_en: DecisionRank is a decision model trained via item-space on-policy distillation to transfer ranking knowledge from a generative LLM teacher. The student's rollout is built by sorting its document scores into a ranked sequence, which the teacher consumes as input to provide a training signal. The goal is to avoid autoregressive decoding latency while bridging the mismatch between ranked ID sequences and first-token scores.
items.why_en: Useful if you build fast rerankers for RAG pipelines and want to avoid LLM decoding cost.

items.title: Video Generation Meets Agent Harness: Agentic Video Generation, Agentic World Modeling and Recursive Self-Improvement
items.snippet: Video generation is shifting from end-to-end synthesis toward agentic generation, where planning, tool use, and feedback enable coherent, controllable multi-shot videos. In parallel, video world models provide action-conditioned observations and predicted futures, serving as interactive environments for agents. We study their intersection through the agent harness: an executable runtime that constructs context, exposes tools, maintains state, routes feedback, and manages budgets around video models. This report examines three directions. First, agentic video generation, where harnesses coordinate scripting, shot planning, asset management, production, and editing, alongside the evaluation ch
items.title_ar: التقاء video generation مع agent harness في التوليد الوكيلي والنماذج العالمية
items.summary_ar: تقرير يدرس تقاطع video generation مع agent harness، وهو runtime قابل للتنفيذ يبني context ويعرض tools ويدير state والميزانيات حول video models. يتناول اتجاهين رئيسيين: agentic video generation حيث تنسق الـ harness مراحل مثل scripting و shot planning و editing، وvideo world models التي تقدم observations مشروطة بالأفعال كبيئات تفاعلية للـ agents. يذكر النص اتجاهاً ثالثاً هو recursive self-improvement دون تفاصيل كافية في الجزء المتاح.
items.why_ar: نمط تصميم الـ harness من tools وstate وfeedback وbudgets قابل لإعادة الاستخدام في POCs للـ agents خارج توليد الفيديو.
items.title_en: Video Generation Meets Agent Harness: Agentic Video and World Models
items.summary_en: A report on the intersection of video generation and the agent harness, an executable runtime that builds context, exposes tools, maintains state, and manages budgets around video models. It covers agentic video generation, where harnesses coordinate scripting, shot planning, asset management, production, and editing, and video world models that provide action-conditioned observations as interactive environments for agents. A third direction, recursive self-improvement, is named in the title but not detailed in the provided text.
items.why_en: The harness design pattern of tools, state, feedback, and budgets is reusable for agentic POCs beyond video.

items.title: Diagnosing the Reference Gap: What Visual Scaffolds Can and Cannot Fix in Multimodal Reasoning
items.snippet: Multimodal large language models can recognize visual content yet struggle to reason reliably over it across multiple steps. In counting, a model may see all objects but lose track of which ones it has counted. We argue that such failures, commonly attributed to perception, reveal a reference gap: the failure to bind language to the relevant visual entities, regions, or locations. Motivated by the theory of visual routines, we test whether external references such as numbering can narrow this gap. We introduce ReGap-Bench, a paired benchmark of five visual reasoning tasks in which the scene, question, and answer are fixed and only the reference varies. Results show that task-matched referenc
items.title_ar: تشخيص reference gap في multimodal reasoning وحدود visual scaffolds
items.summary_ar: يرى البحث أن أخطاء multimodal LLMs في الاستدلال متعدد الخطوات ليست مشكلة إدراك فقط، بل فجوة في ربط اللغة بالكيانات أو المناطق البصرية المقصودة، ويسميها reference gap. يستند الباحثون إلى نظرية visual routines ويختبرون هل تقلص مراجع خارجية مثل الترقيم هذه الفجوة. يقدم الفريق ReGap-Bench، وهو benchmark مزدوج من خمس مهام استدلال بصري يبقى فيه المشهد والسؤال والإجابة ثابتة بينما يتغير المرجع فقط، والنص المتاح مقطوع قبل التفاصيل الكاملة للنتائج.
items.why_ar: فكرة رخيصة تستحق التجربة في POC للـ multimodal reasoning، مثل إضافة مراجع بصرية مرقمة لتحسين العد والاستدلال.
items.title_en: Diagnosing the Reference Gap in Multimodal Reasoning
items.summary_en: The paper argues that multimodal LLM failures in multi-step visual reasoning, such as losing track while counting, stem from a reference gap: the failure to bind language to the relevant visual entities or regions. Motivated by visual routines theory, it tests whether external references like numbering can narrow this gap. It introduces ReGap-Bench, a paired benchmark of five visual reasoning tasks where the scene, question, and answer stay fixed and only the reference varies; the provided text is cut off before the full results.
items.why_en: A cheap idea worth testing in a multimodal POC: adding numbered visual references to help counting and multi-step reasoning.

items.title: MAServeBench: Benchmarking Multi-Agent LLM Serving Systems with Hierarchical Collaboration Workloads
items.snippet: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) coordinate specialized agents to solve complex tasks, turning each user request into interdependent model and tool operations. Unlike independent requests, these operations become ready at different times and consume evolving context as agents coordinate and exchange results. This creates changing patterns of concurrency, computation, and memory demand that can expose different bottlenecks in LLM serving hardware. Yet benchmarking these effects requires capturing the collaboration rules that generate serving workloads, beyond the requests observed during execution. We present MAServeBench, a benchmark that treats multi-agent collabor
items.title_ar: MAServeBench: benchmark لأحمال serving لأنظمة multi-agent LLM
items.summary_ar: يقدم MAServeBench benchmark لقياس أنظمة serving للـ multi-agent systems، حيث تتحول طلبات المستخدم إلى عمليات model وtool مترابطة تصل في أوقات مختلفة. تتغير أنماط concurrency وcomputation وmemory مع تنسيق الـ agents وتبادل النتائج، مما قد يكشف عنق زجاجة مختلفاً في عتاد الـ serving. يلتقط البنشمارك قواعد collaboration التي تولد هذه الأحمال، لا الطلبات المرصودة أثناء التنفيذ فقط.
items.why_ar: مهم لمهندس يخطط لـ capacity وlatency لأنظمة multi-agent في الإنتاج وليس لطلبات chatbot منفردة.
items.title_en: MAServeBench: Benchmarking Multi-Agent LLM Serving Workloads
items.summary_en: MAServeBench is a benchmark for multi-agent LLM serving systems that models hierarchical collaboration as serving workloads. It notes that interdependent model and tool operations become ready at different times and consume evolving context, creating shifting patterns of concurrency, computation, and memory demand. The benchmark captures the collaboration rules that generate these workloads, not only the requests observed during execution.
items.why_en: Relevant when planning serving capacity and latency for production multi-agent systems rather than single-request chatbots.

items.title: On-Policy Self-Distillation with Teacher Evolution
items.snippet: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), which aligns a student model's token-level distribution with that of its self-teacher prompted by privileged context, has emerged as a promising direction to mitigate reward sparsity in sequence-level post-training paradigms. However, OPSD often fails to achieve continuous performance gains during training. In this paper, we find that the model's limited self-teaching capability underlies this phenomenon by generating unreliable guidance on certain samples. items.title_ar: TESD: تطوير الـ self-teacher في On-Policy Self-Distillation
items.summary_ar: يشرح البحث أن OPSD، الذي يوائم token-level distribution للـ student مع self-teacher مدعوم بسياق مميز، يخفف reward sparsity لكنه لا يحقق تحسناً مستمراً أثناء التدريب. السبب المقترح أن قدرة self-teaching المحدودة تولد guidance غير موثوق في بعض العينات. يقترح الباحثون TESD، حيث يولد الـ self-teacher rollouts ويستقبل environmental feedback مبنياً على صحة المهمة.
items.why_ar: تقنية تستحق المتابعة لمن يدرب موديلات بـ post-training ويواجه reward sparsity وتوقفاً في التحسن.
items.title_en: On-Policy Self-Distillation with Teacher Evolution
items.summary_en: The paper examines On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), which aligns a student's token-level distribution with a self-teacher prompted by privileged context, as a way to mitigate reward sparsity. The authors find OPSD often fails to deliver continuous gains because the model's limited self-teaching produces unreliable guidance on some samples. They propose Teacher-Evolution Self-Distillation (TESD), where the self-teacher generates rollouts and receives environmental feedback based on task correctness.
items.why_en: Relevant if you run post-training with sparse rewards and see self-distillation gains plateau.

items.title_ar: مجلة القافلة السعودية تستعرض 73 عاماً من التحولات حتى AI
